title: International Trade and Institutional Change: Medieval Venice’s Response to Globalization
lineage: Inspected indicated passages; local file contains paraphrased research notes.

passages.note: The authors reproduce and translate an August 1199 colleganza: Giovanni Agadi supplied 300 pounds, Zaccaria Stagnario received it for trade; profits were split three quarters to Agadi, one quarter to Stagnario, with specific maritime and human risks on the investor. The source does not establish voyage outcomes.
